scenarios.description: Hovering a ready generated card fades in an outline and right-click hint without changing composer state.
Right-clicking a ready card prevents the native menu, selects it and writes its reference into the composer.
Right-clicking another card moves the persistent selected treatment and replaces the composer reference.
Removing the composer reference clears the selected card treatment.
A loading card does not intercept right-click or become selected.
Selection remains visible while fade transitions are disabled when reduced motion is requested.
